spec_hint: Log jigsaw puzzles: name, brand, pieces, start/finish dates, rating, notes, done or wishlist → sortable shelf with totals and average time per piece; localStorage.
Log a mistake: what happened, category, what I'll do next time → list with repeat-category counts and a 'seen this before' flag; localStorage.
Drop an image, type max KB and/or max pixels → steps JPEG quality and dimensions on canvas until it fits, shows result size, download.
Table of domains, tools, accounts: name, provider, cost, cycle, renewal date (no passwords) → yearly cost total, upcoming renewals highlighted; localStorage, JSON export.
Add subscriptions: name, price, monthly/yearly, next renewal, category → monthly and yearly totals, renewals in next 30 days, cancel checklist; localStorage.
Set weekly category budgets, log spends; each week under budget earns gold to build village buildings drawn on canvas; overspend damages them; localStorage.
Pick two cooking days and meals per week from a built-in batch-cook list → which batch covers each day, fridge/freezer notes, combined shopping list.
Button → random corporate mission statement from built-in buzzword phrase lists (verbs, adverbs, adjectives, nouns); copy button, another one.
Pick many local GIF files or a folder → grid of animated thumbnails, size slider, click to view full size with name and dimensions.
Paste HTML and CSS, set width/height → render via SVG foreignObject to live preview, download as SVG or PNG.
Paste CSS → minified output where rules with identical declarations are merged into one comma selector list; shows bytes saved, copy.
Load a local audio file → side-scrolling walker; terrain height, colours and sky react to bass, mids and beats via Web Audio analyser.
Paste or open a text document → word counts, top words, and top positive and negative words using a built-in sentiment word list.
Add friends with how often to keep in touch → list sorted by overdue, one tap logs contact today with a note; localStorage.
Add restaurants, then dishes marked re-order or avoid with notes → searchable list showing what to get and skip at each place; localStorage.
Tick Windows shortcuts from a built-in list, pick screen size and colours → wallpaper PNG with a clean shortcut grid, download.
Open a local pattern PDF in the page beside big row and repeat counters, saved per pattern file name with a note; localStorage.
Type number of questions → big table of wrong-answer counts to percent and letter grade; tap a row for the current student; editable grade cut-offs.
wish: someone should make an easy grader app for teachers

spec_hint: Keep a pool of goals and tasks; each morning it offers a few options, you pick three, tick them off; streak and history; localStorage.
Salary, contracted and real hours, commute time, unpaid overtime, work costs → effective hourly wage versus nominal, with breakdown.
Log staples as you finish them (item, amount, date) → usage per week per item and how much to buy in bulk for N weeks; localStorage.
Canvas game: grimy window, drag a squeegee to wipe it clean, percent clean and timer, new dirtier window each level.
Big tap area, 5/10/30 second rounds → taps per second, best score per round length saved locally.
Type text → it fills the whole screen at the largest fitting size, colour choices, rotate, optional scrolling marquee, fullscreen button.
Endless vertical swipe feed of built-in drawn animals, shapes and colours with synthesized sounds; no links out, no ads; gentle stop after N cards.
Set several reminders with label and interval (every N minutes) and active hours → chime and on-screen notice while the page is open.
Add topics, record dated belief statements and confidence → per-topic timeline showing how each view shifted; localStorage, export.
Enter assignment, due date, parts with effort estimates, days off → daily plan of what to do each day until due, tick off; localStorage.
Add things you want as cart items with price; log savings → items fill and 'check out' when funded; totals; localStorage.
Huge tap target counts laps, shows lap times, total distance from typed lap length, pace; wake lock; history saved locally.
List family documents (passport, licence, insurance) with owner and expiry date → sorted by soonest, warnings at 6 and 3 months; .ics export; localStorage.
Log movies, books, games, shows with genre, rating, date → one list plus stats: top genres, average ratings by type, per-year counts; localStorage.
Tap preset or custom drinks with caffeine mg → today's total, timeline, week chart, user-set daily limit marker; localStorage.
Set percent, size, stroke, colours, label → live SVG ring preview, copy SVG/CSS code, download SVG.
Paste bash history → stats on top commands, repeated long commands worth aliasing, cd/ls churn, missed shortcuts, and an overall score with tips.
Load audio or start blank → spectrogram canvas; paint or erase frequencies, resynthesize via inverse FFT, play and download WAV.
Canvas 2D particle-spring sandbox: draw jelly, wood, glass, or metal shapes that bend, break and shatter; drag and drop them.
Add subnets in CIDR → per-subnet IP table to assign hosts, notes, free/used counts, overlap warnings; localStorage, CSV export.
Synthesized vuvuzela drone via Web Audio: crowd-size, loudness and pitch sliders, play/stop, optional timer.
Set active hours and how many checks per day → plays a soft tone at random times while open, shows a reality-check prompt, logs checks.
Uses device compass and typed or GPS position → arrow and distance toward chosen cities from a built-in world city list.
One-screen game whose character talks to the player, notices window resizes, tab switches, idle time and reloads, and plays with them.
Log volunteer sessions (org, date, hours) and donations (amount) → totals per year and organisation, printable summary; localStorage, CSV.
Paste text → one tap or key copies the next line to the clipboard, shows position; optional timer mode advancing every N seconds.
Pick an earlier photo → live camera view with it as an adjustable translucent overlay to line up, take and download the new photo.
Paste text, set character limit (280 default) → number of posts needed and the text split at word boundaries with 1/n numbering, copy each.
Guided questions (goals, what went well, what didn't, causes, actions) → formatted lessons-learned report to copy or print; draft saved locally.
Enter latitude/longitude or pick a city → date of earliest sunset and latest sunrise this winter, with a chart of sunset times across the year.
Pick key and length → random simple beginner-level guitar tab riff in ASCII, play it with synthesized plucks, regenerate, copy.
Open Skype export messages.json → conversation list, readable chat view with dates, search, export a conversation as text or HTML.
Create custom trackers (counter, number, yes/no) → one-tap logging with timestamps, per-tracker chart and history; localStorage, CSV export.
